summary: Both full halves inspected. The initial c and h of chain are continuous pen retouches over the typed letters. The cancelled Whwat has an uncertain middle w-like letter and detached cup/arch fragments around its h, now preserved neutrally. Isomorphic has typed i over a. The cancelled phrase after taken reads on F, with x cancellation in its space. The physical argu/ment break is joined without supplying a cropped hyphen. The circled margin gives the inverse limit over B-circle and is drawn as an actual annotation. The old inline limit subscript has a first B and a second partly covered B-like serifed form; it is not a secure B-hat and remains doubtful under the corrected B-circle. The inserted in before D(Ab) is typed. The live H in RHom is clear, but its older h-like base and exact pen/type provenance remain uncertain, represented by a neutral superposition. Thus has no added comma: the following t is pen over a typed a. Hand-filled carets, Gamma symbols, comparison signs, and the final augmentation arrow are marked.
